北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风大天寒，体感 -8℃，出门多穿点，别冻着了！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is windy and cold, feeling like -8℃. Dress warmly to stay cozy!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪北风 5级，体感 1℃。风寒，记得添衣保暖哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has a 5-level north wind, feeling like 1℃. It's chilly, remember to dress warmly!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海体感 2℃，西风微凉。多喝热水，注意保暖。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels like 2℃ with a gentle west wind. Drink hot water and keep warm.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州天晴，体感 14℃，早晚温差大。小心着凉哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny, feels like 14℃. Big temperature difference, watch out for colds!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光正好，体感 16℃。早晚凉，别忘了带件外套。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen has lovely sun, feels like 16℃. Cool mornings/evenings, don't forget a jacket.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州体感 4℃，空气干燥。多喝水，小心风寒感冒。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou feels like 4℃, dry air. Drink more water and beware of cold.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京体感 2℃，风有点凉。记得多穿点，别着凉。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing feels like 2℃, a bit chilly. Remember to layer up and avoid catching a cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天湿度大，体感 5℃。出门带伞，谨防湿冷。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and humid, feels like 5℃. Take an umbrella, beware of damp cold.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉天晴，体感 6℃。午后暖和，但早晚温差大。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny, feels like 6℃. Warmer afternoons, but big temperature changes.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安体感 0℃，北风微凉。注意头部和颈部保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an feels like 0℃ with a slight north wind. Keep your head and neck warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，湿度 76%。开车出行，注意交通安全。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy with 76% humidity. Drive safely if you're out and about.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒，体感 -24℃！全副武装，注意防冻伤。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, feels like -24℃! Bundle up to prevent frostbite.
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -24℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳天冷风大，体感 -19℃。保暖要紧，多加衣物。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cold and windy, feels like -19℃. Stay warm, add more layers.
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -19℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，南风 4级。体感 5℃，出门注意防风。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy with a 4-level south wind. Feels like 5℃, wear windproof clothes.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门风力 5级，体感 11℃。风寒效应明显，多穿点。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has a 5-level wind, feels like 11℃. Wind chill is strong, dress warmly.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛北风 6级，体感 -11℃！一定要穿最厚的衣服！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has a 6-level north wind, feels like -11℃! Wear your warmest clothes!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连体感 -14℃，风大天冷。帽子围巾手套，一个都不能少。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian feels like -14℃, windy and cold. Don't forget hat, scarf, and gloves.
